GRASIM.attchmntText: Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
GRASIM.voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited filed a presentation on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 stood at 50,105 crore rupees, up 26% year-on-year. Standalone revenue reached an all-time high of 12,747 crore rupees, up 33% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA increased by 25% year-on-year to 6,513 crore rupees. Standalone EBITDA was 1,326 crore rupees. Adjusted profit after tax for the standalone entity was 3,132 crore rupees. The company reported total lending portfolio growth of 32% year-on-year to 2,33,930 crore rupees. Cellulosic Fibres revenue grew 29% year-on-year to 5,344 crore rupees. Cement revenue rose 19% year-on-year to 23,295 crore rupees. Chemicals revenue increased 15% year-on-year to 2,759 crore rupees.

GRASIM.attchmntText: Press release on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
GRASIM.voiceSummary: Grasim Industries Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue reached an all-time high of Rs. 12,747 Cr., up 33% year-on-year. Standalone EBITDA was Rs. 4,615 Cr., up 158% year-on-year. Adjusted profit after tax before exceptional items stood at Rs. 3,132 Cr., up 289% year-on-year. Reported profit after tax was Rs. 2,306 Cr., up 187% year-on-year, after an exceptional charge of Rs. 825 Cr. Consolidated revenue was Rs. 50,105 Cr., up 26% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 6,513 Cr., up 25% year-on-year. Consolidated reported profit after tax was a loss of Rs. 234 Cr., accounting for an exceptional charge of Rs. 767 Cr. The company also disclosed a standalone dividend from UltraTech of Rs. 3,968 Cr.

GRASIM.attchmntText: Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026

TVSMOTOR.attchmntText: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR EXPANDS BRAZIL OPERATIONS AND REINFORCES LONG-TERM COMMITMENT".
TVSMOTOR.voiceSummary: TVS Motor Company announced the expansion of its Brazil operations on November 13, 2026. The company opened its first Flagship Store in São Paulo at Avenida dos Bandeirantes, 1747, Vila Olímpia. Production capacity is currently approximately 110,000 units in 2026 and is planned to increase to 130,000 units by 2027. TVS Motor is partnering with Mottu to expand its retail network, with three new stores planned during 2027. This partnership provides access to approximately 500 points of sale and 168 service locations across Brazil. The announcement reinforces the company's long-term commitment to the Brazilian market.

PAYTM.attchmntText: One 97 Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,2015 regarding 'In-principle authorisation granted by the Reserve Bank of India to Paytm Payments Services Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, for Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI)'.
PAYTM.voiceSummary: One 97 Communications Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, Paytm Payments Services Limited, received in-principle authorization from the Reserve Bank of India on November 13, 2026. The subsidiary can offer pre-paid instruments, such as wallets, to customers only after receiving final authorization or a certificate of authorization from the regulator. This disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. A copy of the RBI letter is annexed to the announcement.

HDFCAMC.attchmntText: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled " HDFC Mutual Fund Enters the SIF Space with H-SIF to Unlock New Investment Opportunities for India s Evolving Investors ".
HDFCAMC.voiceSummary: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited issued a press release regarding the launch of H-SIF, its Specialized Investment Fund platform. The first strategy, H-SIF Hybrid Long-Short Fund, is an interval investment strategy investing in equity and debt securities with limited short exposure through derivatives. The New Fund Offer period is from November 13, 2026, to November 27, 2026. The minimum investment is Rs. 10 lakh across SIF strategies at the PAN level, while accredited investors can invest a minimum of Rs. 10,000. Subscriptions are available daily, and redemptions occur twice a week on Mondays and Wednesdays. An exit load of 0.5% applies to units redeemed or switched out within 90 days of allotment. The investment strategy is proposed to be listed on NSE and or BSE.

PFC.attchmntText: Incorporation of wholly owned Subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited (a wholly owned Subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- Mahasamund Power Transmission Limited
PFC.voiceSummary: Power Finance Corporation Limited has incorporated Mahasamund Power Transmission Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited. This Special Purpose Vehicle is designated for the 400KV S/S Pithora transmission scheme. PFC Consulting Limited serves as the Bid Process Coordinator for this Independent Transmission Project under Ministry of Power guidelines. The subsidiary will handle preparatory activities including land acquisition and forest clearance. It will be transferred to the successful bidder selected through the tariff-based competitive bidding process. The Central Electricity Authority and Grid India nominated PFC Consulting Limited as the coordinator during meetings held on 12.02.2026 and 13.02.2026. Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited approved this nomination via Letter of Intent No. 02-19/T-26/519 dated 03.07.2026. The announcement is dated 13.11.2026.

MARICO.attchmntText: Please find attached a press release by Marico Limited, titled  Marico unveils Nihar Shanti Mazbooti Ki Paathshala, a renewed identity for its flagship CSR education initiative .
MARICO.voiceSummary: Marico Limited filed a press release on November 13, 2026, announcing the rebranding of its flagship CSR education initiative. The program, previously known as Nihar Shanti Paathshala Funwala, is now named Nihar Shanti Mazbooti Ki Paathshala. This change aligns the initiative with the Nihar Shanti brand identity, emphasizing strong decision-making. The initiative focuses on foundational literacy and numeracy for children in underserved communities. Since its inception, the program has trained over 1.26 lakh teachers and benefited approximately 12.69 lakh students. In FY2025-26, it supported over 3,500 children aged 3 to 6 years, 260 Anganwadi workers and helpers, and over 1,500 parents. The disclosure was submitted to BSE Limited and NSE for information and records.

The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 9,867.34 million, compared to Rs. 8,089.79 million in the previous year. Profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 1,296.90 million, versus Rs. 1,366.49 million previously. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5,306.50 million. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 588.00 million, compared to Rs. 737.29 million in the prior year quarter. The Statutory Auditor issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. The results are available on the company website.

SUPRIYA.attchmntText: Supriya Lifescience Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
SUPRIYA.voiceSummary: Supriya Lifescience Limited filed a notice regarding the transcript of the Earnings Call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 06, 2026. Revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at INR206 crores, a 3.2% year-on-year increase. EBITDA was INR45 crores, a 37.5% decline, with an EBITDA margin of 22%. PAT was INR29 crores. For H1 FY27, revenue was INR396 crores, a 14.8% increase. EBITDA was INR93 crores, a 25.3% decline, with a margin of 23.4%. PAT was INR53 crores. The company revised its full-year EBITDA margin guidance downwards to 23% to 25%. Management cited regulatory changes in the LATAM market, higher operating expenses at the Ambernath facility, and increased raw material costs as reasons for the margin decline. Exports accounted for 80% of Q2 revenue. Mr. Mangesh Vaze joined as Chief Operating Officer.

IMFA.attchmntText: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
IMFA.voiceSummary: Indian Metals and Ferro Alloys Limited announces that the Special Resolution for the appointment of Mr Partha Satpathy, DIN 11589079, as a Non-Executive Independent Director has been approved by members. The resolution was passed via postal ballot conducted through remote e-voting. The voting period commenced on 14th October 2026 and ended on 12th November 2026. The record date for eligibility was 09th October 2026. Scrutinizer Mr Sourjya Prakash Mohapatra of R K P Associates confirmed the results. Out of 53954106 shares entitled to vote, 37719694 votes were cast in favor, representing 99.99 percent of valid votes. Three hundred thirty-nine votes were cast against the resolution. The appointment is for a period of three years effective from 08th September 2026. The company filed this result with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 13th November 2026.

PICCADIL.attchmntText: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
PICCADIL.voiceSummary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited filed an earnings presentation for the six months and quarter ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 grew 19% year-on-year to Rs 278 crore. EBITDA increased 9.5% to Rs 53 crore. Profit after tax was Rs 24.2 crore, down 9% from the previous year. For the half-year, total income rose 19.1% to Rs 553 crore. EBITDA grew 14.5% to Rs 100 crore. Profit after tax was Rs 46 crore, up 1.2%. Distillery revenue grew 30.5% to Rs 271.3 crore in the quarter. The company reported 25,750 retail outlets and operations in 33 countries. Expansion at Indri and Chhattisgarh facilities is complete. Capacity utilization is improving.

JUSTDIAL.attchmntText: VSS Mani has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
JUSTDIAL.voiceSummary: Just Dial Limited disclosed promoter share encumbrance details on October 2, 2026. Promoter V.S.S. Mani created an encumbrance on 2,39,647 shares, representing 0.28 percent of total share capital, on September 28, 2026. The shares were encumbered in favor of Reliance Retail Ventures Limited under the type Others. This event increased V.S.S. Mani's total encumbered holding to 67,07,834 shares, or 7.89 percent of the total share capital. Concurrently, promoter Eshwary Krishnan released an encumbrance on 2,39,647 shares, also representing 0.28 percent of the total share capital, on September 28, 2026. The release was in favor of Reliance Retail Ventures Limited. Following this release, Eshwary Krishnan holds no encumbered shares. The disclosure cites a Shareholders Agreement dated July 16, 2021, as the basis for these encumbrances. Other promoters including Anita Mani, V. Krishnan, and Manasi Iyer reported no changes to their encumbrance status during this reporting period.

ZAGGLE.attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee / Compensation Committee Meeting held on November 13, 2026 regarding Grant of Options under Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022
ZAGGLE.voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited granted 77,071 stock options to eligible employees under the Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved this grant on November 13, 2026. Each option is convertible into one equity share with a face value of ₹ 1. The exercise price is set at ₹ 130 per stock option. This price reflects a 25% discount to the closing market price on November 12, 2026. Options are exercisable from the vesting date until ten years after the final tranche vests. The allotted shares are not subject to any lock-in period. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations, 2021.

OSWALPUMPS.attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
OSWALPUMPS.voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited has declared the voting results for the postal ballot notice dated October 12, 2026. The special resolution regarding the approval of variation of the objects or terms of utilization of the initial public offering proceeds and modification of the time limit for the utilization of the initial public offering proceeds has been passed. The scrutinizer, Mr. Amit Kumar Shukla, reported that out of 11,40,04,897 outstanding shares, 8,66,43,406 valid votes were polled. Of these, 8,66,39,508 votes were in favor, representing 99.996 percent, while 3,898 votes were against, representing 0.004 percent. The remote e-voting period ran from October 13, 2026, to November 11, 2026. The resolution is deemed passed as of November 11, 2026. The company has submitted the voting results and the scrutinizer's report to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 13, 2026.

OSWALPUMPS.attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange about Strategy Presentation.
OSWALPUMPS.voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited filed a strategy presentation with BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The company is a fully integrated provider of solar pumping systems with backward integration into pumps, motors, solar panels, and mounting structures. Orders executed as of October 31, 2026, totaled 66,508 units. The distributor network reached 1,462 as of September 30, 2026. Revenue from turnkey solar pumping systems accounted for 64.4% in H1 FY27. Government entities contributed 65.1% of revenue in H1 FY27. The company operates two manufacturing facilities with ISO certifications. Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited secured an order for grid-connected rooftop solar plants under the PM-Surya Ghar Scheme. The presentation includes forward-looking statements and risk disclosures.

OSWALPUMPS.attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
OSWALPUMPS.voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company reported revenue from operations of 5,063 million rupees, a 6.9 percent quarter-on-quarter increase. Operating EBITDA was 574 million rupees with an 11.3 percent margin. Profit after tax stood at 396 million rupees. The solar pump order book is at 9,487 pumps. The company is diversifying into rooftop, utility-scale, and commercial and industrial solar segments with a combined order book of 143 megawatts. Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited plans to establish a 1.2 gigawatt TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility. This initiative is subject to shareholder approval. The presentation is available on the company website.

OSWALPUMPS.attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Total Income stood at INR. 5,118 million in Q2 FY27, up 6.2% QoQ".
OSWALPUMPS.voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited reported unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27. Total income was Rs. 5,118 million, up 6.2% quarter-on-quarter. EBITDA stood at Rs. 628 million with a margin of 12.3%. Profit after tax was Rs. 396 million, with a margin of 7.7%. Diluted EPS was Rs. 3.34. The Board took on record these results on 12th November 2026. The company has announced plans to establish a 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Karnal, Haryana. The total project cost is estimated at Rs. 4,558.5 million. Funding includes Rs. 2,960.0 million through debt. Rs. 1,598.5 million is proposed from unutilized IPO proceeds. This reallocation is subject to shareholders’ approval. The pump order book stands at 9,487 pumps. The combined order book for rooftop, utility-scale, and commercial solar segments is approximately 143 MW.
